title: PARC: Adaptive Predictive Location Updating in Mobile Computing Networks — Simulation Code and Results
description: Simulation code, raw per-subscriber results and analysis scripts for the paper 'Exploiting Subscriber Mobility Regularity for Adaptive Location Updating in Mobile Computing Networks'. Implements four classical location update strategies (time-based, distance-based, movement-based, profile-based) and two proposed algorithms (PARC and the hybrid PARC-H) on a 127-cell hexagonal mesh under three mobility models across seven call-to-mobility ratio operating points, with 560 paired per-subscriber observations.
